name: BusinessCompiler
description: Ultimate AI‑native Business Compiler: given a business category, it automatically discovers the business DNA, builds a universal ontology, creates a formal Business Intermediate Representation (BIR), and compiles a complete business operating system — data model, executable workflows, responsive UI forms and live KPI dashboards, advanced multi‑dimensional analytics (financial statements, cohort/retention analysis, benchmarking, anomaly detection, a business health score), per‑audience views (Executive, Operations, Financial, CRM, Team, Growth, Technical diagrams, Board, Field), a hierarchy of specialized AI agents plus a strategic business‑reasoning layer (structured decision frameworks like unit‑economics, scenario comparison, SWOT) and a system‑health meta‑agent that watches the AI workforce itself, an actions/automations engine with reminders and escalation, WhatsApp Business integration, a voice/phone agent, a social‑media marketing suite, a marketing module (segmentation, funnels, paid ads, A/B testing, multi‑touch attribution, drip sequences, loyalty), a full CRM (sales pipeline, lead scoring, support ticketing with SLAs, customer‑360), native double‑entry accounting & finance (chart of accounts, ledger auto‑posted from workflows, multi‑currency, tax, budgets, period close), inventory & supply chain, asset/equipment tracking with IoT telemetry and predictive maintenance, HR & payroll, a knowledge base and document module that grounds customer‑facing agents, a generic framework for integrating with any third‑party platform, PLUS this business's own outbound API and webhook platform so other systems can integrate into it, RBAC/ABAC security, simulation & forecasting engines, and a final comprehensive QA pass checking business logic, AI logic, and cross‑module consistency before the compile is called done. Every full compile is written into the same clustered directory structure (Foundation/Intelligence/Operations/Growth/Finance/Platform/Delivery, plus a master index) regardless of business niche, so results are consistently organized and easy to navigate. Outputs a ready‑to‑deploy specification (JSON/YAML + Markdown) and a step‑by‑step deployment guide. The compiler is domain‑aware (plant nursery, laundry, car‑wash, SaaS, health‑clinic, urban farm, etc.) and can generate code‑ready artifacts, documentation, and test suites.
examples: /business-compiler Plant nursery – full plant‑inventory, watering schedules, sales, subscriptions and AI‑driven stock forecasts
/business-compiler Multi‑branch laundry management with inventory, pickup/delivery, employees, accounting, CRM, automation and AI
/business-compiler Car wash business with vehicle types, wash packages, service bays, technician queues, IoT sensor integration and profitability simulation
/business-compiler Subscription‑based SaaS platform with customer billing, tiered pricing, usage metering, upgrade workflows and revenue forecasting
/business-compiler Urban farm vertical‑hydroponics system with crop cycles, resource tracking, worker shifts, financial KPIs and climate‑control automation
/business-compiler Health clinic with patient intake, appointments, billing, inventory of medical supplies, compliance rules and AI triage agent
/business-compiler Boutique fitness studio with class bookings, WhatsApp reminders, an AI front-desk agent, Instagram/TikTok content suite and a loyalty program
/business-compiler How would you run and analyze a multi-location pet grooming chain — give me the dashboards, analytics, and an AI advisor for whether to open a third location
/business-compiler Accounting firm with client bookkeeping, invoicing, a sales pipeline for new clients, and payroll for a 6-person team
/business-compiler A franchise car wash chain — I need it to expose an API so franchisee POS systems can sync sales back, plus IoT sensors on the wash equipment for predictive maintenance
/business-compiler /include‑sections Analytics,Views,AIAgents,Automations,WhatsApp,SocialMedia,Marketing,CRM,Accounting,Inventory,Assets,HR,Knowledge,Integrations,API to get only the requested parts
